subject: Stage-2 ping image built (P17): probe350mcuping a66dc14e; host step 3 (cmd 0/10/1, CSRAM plan, pin fallback) done
body:
STAGE-2 PING IMAGE BUILT (P17, patch 0115), host-only, NOT run, NOT flashed; needs the user's approval before any boot. This is the only MCUPM image that writes.
- probe350mcuping (n2mcu=2 n2mcuping=1) sha256 a66dc14e59d17526dab25a2b5860cedbcd77439f62ce254237ab2496377c3d0b, cmdline 605 chars (limit 607), path gpu/build/device-mmu-p17-candidate/probe350mcuping/nord2-ios-metal-p17-probe350mcuping-stop23.img
- kernel p17a sha256 a9d928f20e342cdeaf1bc9cfea7d7588889b960f675b01711421a20c72d1ed38; patch 0115-mcupm-stage2-ping-n2mcuping.patch a35de5aab27718af (xnu-side only: nord2_cpufreq.c + nord2_mcupm_scan.h), test nord2_mcupm_scan_test.c (preconditions, outcome classes A-D, protocol constants).
What it does, exactly as README-0107-design.md 12.6 step 2: at boot+60 s after the read-only snapshot pass, only if all four control regs are 0 and TASK_STA==1: three 32-bit stores {0xdead,0,0} to 0x1031fce0..e8, dsb, one store of 1 to 0x10300154, poll 0x10300078 bit0 and 0x10300150 bit0 every 50 us for 20 ms, on reply read 4 words at 0x1031fd30 and store 1 to 0x10300074; then 5 s of 100 ms samples of all mailboxes + window tail 0x8000..0xb800 printing every change; prints outcome A (reply, word!=0), B (reply, word 0), C (consumed/changed, no reply), D (nothing). Once per boot, no retry, nothing written to mbox3/4, CSRAM, no SPI enabled; refuses with n2mcu=3.
Residual risks for the approval: the first store into the control page 0x10300154 has never been done (reads of the page are proven); the firmware's handler for 0xdead before PLT_INIT is unspecified; worst case MCUPM dead until next boot, CPUs unaffected (PWR_CTRL_EN=AP_READY=0).
HOST STEP DONE (cpuhvfs-step3/, README 12.7): the AP-side DVFS hand-over decoded from the vendor source: cmd 0 {0,0,x,x}; cmd 10 per cluster {10,j,Vproc,Vsram} in 10 uV units read from MT6315 SID6 VBUCK1 / SID7 VBUCK3 and MT6359P VSRAM_PROC1/2; cmd 1 {1,level,x,x}; the AP DOES write the level-1 OPP table into CSRAM (+0x10, 4x36 words) and the CCI map (+0xfa0). Pure tested functions: nord2_cpuhvfs_init.h (csram plan, row selection, messages, PMIC decode, rails), golden image from an independent Python reimplementation of the vendor code, generator --check against the vendor table header, 8 header + 1 table mutations fail the test. IMPORTANT hazard found: vendor init zeroes the request words (+0x37c) = row 0 = FASTEST row; the pinned plan (min=max=request=row from the measured clock: LL row1 1800/950mV, L row14 700/650mV, B row15 659/650mV) avoids it. Fallback n2dv_fallback_pin defined. DVFS bring-up stays NO-GO until ping + platform init. run_all.sh gate on P17 is queued behind other heavy gates.
